render.scope: Complete unedited source drawing sheets; original PDF preserved.

introduction: Explore fifteen complete building floorplate sheets and three separately attributed 1 BR preview images, with full-size zoom and original-source links.
selectorLabel: Choose a complete building level or broker home preview
note: Fifteen complete original building sheets show the ground, podium 2, residential levels 1–14 and roof, including the printed paired-level sheets and duplex upper levels. Podium 1 is absent from this packet. Three separate freely displayed broker images add 1 BR typical, Type 04 and Type 07 previews. Those standalone images show no printed saleable areas or numbered-unit references. The broker’s remaining drawings require a form and were not retrieved. Confirm contractual unit matching, duplex levels and final areas with Imtiaz.
